technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: MLB based BCMs  (Address 09-Cent Elektroniği) such as the 4G Chassis A6 Kontrol edin: the fuse that powers T17e/16 at J519.
On 2012-2014 NAR market A6 models that happens to be fuse SD9 (30 Amp) but the fuse number/position needs to be checked per the Official Factory Repair Information.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Mk6 Golf (PQ35) based models using a  09-Cent. Elect./BCM (J519) module that contains Component: PQ35 Kontrol edin: the fuse that powers terminal T52c/42 at J519.  If the fuse is blown, fuse panel is melting (as per the next note) or Terminal 30 power is not getting to T52c/42 at J519 the vehicle will have this DTC in addition to numerous right side light bulb faults.  Depending on the equipment of the vehicle components such as M8, M10, M2, M3, M17, M31, M31, M32, L23 and M7 may be powered via J519 on this Terminal 30 (Right) circuit.
Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri diagrams can be obtained from erWin directly: Official Factory Repair Information.
